requirements: R1: The docker-compose.yml file must be present at the repository root to allow launching the full stack.

slices.title: Restore docker-compose.yml to repository root
slices.jtbd: When implementing the orchestration fix for this epic, I want to ensure docker-compose.yml exists at the root, so that the stack can be launched successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository is cloned
When the root directory is inspected
Then a docker-compose.yml file is present
Given the docker-compose.yml is present
When the launch command is executed
Then the system starts without 'file not found' errors
